title: PlasmicMC
description: The official PlasmicMC modpack, required to join the server, now on Modrinth!
body:
# **PlasmicMC: Cobblemon Adventure Awaits!**

Welcome to PlasmicMC, a custom Cobblemon Modpack built for our community server — where Pokémon meet Minecraft in a whole new way! 🎮✨
Catch, train, and explore a world full of adventures, challenges, and discoveries.


# **🧭 Features**

⚔️ Cobblemon – The heart of the pack! Catch and battle your favorite Pokémon in the Minecraft world. (Available Pokémon expanded by AllTheMons x Mega Showdown!)
🌿 Exploration & Biomes – Discover stunning new biomes, structures, and secrets scattered across the map.
⚙️ Optimized Performance – Carefully tuned to offer smooth gameplay even with many mods.
🤝 Multiplayer-Ready - This pack is designed for the official PlasmicMC server, but you can also enjoy it in singleplayer!
Join our growing community and take part in events, tournaments, and trades.


**🌐 Server IP: plasmicmc.minecraft.best**


# **🧩 Recommended Setup**

📦 Minecraft Version: 1.21.x (Fabric)

🚀 RAM: 4–8 GB recommended

🔧 Launcher: This upload is specifically for the Modrinth Launcher.

❤️ Credits: Big thanks to the Cobblemon Team and all the incredible mod creators who made this adventure possible!


# **🌠 Ready to Begin?**

Download PlasmicMC Cobblemon today and start your Pokémon journey — block by block! 🪄🐉
